consensus-spx: SPY is already about 4 points above the full-year +11% target with a quarter left. The earnings-led thesis held; whether it finishes ahead depends on Q4.
small-caps: Small caps led through much of 2026, but IWM fell about 5.6% in the last 30 days as Treasury yields rose and the Fed turned more hawkish. That is the opposite of the falling-rates premise, and it erased the lead, so IWM is now level with SPY.
rotation: The basket only keeps pace because energy is up around 39–40%. Healthcare and industrials trail SPY and financials are flat, so the broad 'rotate out of tech' idea mostly failed; one sector carried it. The energy driver has not been researched yet.
gs-equities-over-credit: Equities returned about 15% against roughly flat high-yield credit, as GS argued: tight spreads left little upside in credit while earnings carried stocks.
pimco-value: No reliable current year-to-date figures for the value and growth indices were found, so this call is not yet scored.
ubs-healthcare: Healthcare is up about 10% but lags SPY by 3.5–5.7 points. Market leadership stayed with tech (QQQ +24%), which typically leaves defensive, low-correlation sectors behind. The drug-pricing catalyst has not been checked.
ubs-utilities: The worst call: utilities are down about 4.5% while SPY is up 15%. Utilities are rate-sensitive, and rising Treasury yields late in the year are a plausible drag that the AI power-demand story did not offset. Data confidence is low because one source shows the opposite sign.
ubs-banks: Banks are up about 8%, half of SPY, and the broad financials ETF is roughly flat. The ROE and deregulation thesis has not translated into relative performance yet. Causes not researched.
hsbc-broadening: Off track because two of its three legs, utilities and financials, are flat or down; only industrials (+10–11%) delivered. Diversifying away from tech cost about 12–14 points so far.
ai-exposure: Staying with AI was the best broad call: QQQ is up about 24%, beating SPY by roughly 8–9 points. The 'broadening beyond tech' trade did not happen.
